notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md, references/advanced-patterns.md in full. The skill gives Express/Fastify setup, layered architecture, middleware (JWT auth, Zod validation, rate limiting, logging), error handling, DI, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, Redis caching and response-format patterns as TypeScript samples.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access for the agent; sample code reads configuration and secrets from environment variables in the user's own application, which is the recommended practice (SKILL.md:30).

Code-review caveats for users: UserRepository.update (details.md:261-278) interpolates object keys into the SQL SET clause, so field names must be whitelisted; CacheService.invalidatePattern uses Redis KEYS (advanced-patterns.md:347), which blocks on large datasets. SKILL.md:45 points to a separate javascript-testing-patterns skill as optional reading.
